description: This Java class defines the 'Order' entity in an e-commerce system, including fields for order details, status, associated products, billing, shipping, and payment information.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer order, including order details, status, products, billing, delivery, and payment info.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the order.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the order.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Returns the date when the order was last modified, clones the Date object to prevent mutation.

methods.name: setLastModified
methods.description: Sets the date when the order was last modified, clones the Date object.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Returns the purchase date of the order, clones the Date object.

methods.name: setDatePurchased
methods.description: Sets the purchase date of the order, clones the Date object.

methods.name: getOrderDateFinished
methods.description: Returns the date when the order was finished, clones the Date object.

methods.name: setOrderDateFinished
methods.description: Sets the finish date of the order, clones the Date object.

methods.name: getCurrencyValue
methods.description: Returns the exchange rate value for the currency.

methods.name: setCurrencyValue
methods.description: Sets the exchange rate value for the currency.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount for the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the order.

methods.name: getIpAddress
methods.description: Returns the IP address associated with the order.

methods.name: setIpAddress
methods.description: Sets the IP address associated with the order.

methods.name: getPaymentModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the payment module code used for the order.

methods.name: setPaymentModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the payment module code used for the order.

methods.name: getShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the shipping module code used for the order.

methods.name: setShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the shipping module code used for the order.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency associated with the order.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the order.

methods.name: getMerchant
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the order.

methods.name: setMerchant
methods.description: Sets the merchant store associated with the order.

methods.name: getOrderProducts
methods.description: Returns the set of products in the order.

methods.name: setOrderProducts
methods.description: Sets the products included in the order.

methods.name: getOrderTotal
methods.description: Returns the set of totals for different components of the order.

methods.name: setOrderTotal
methods.description: Sets the totals for the order.

methods.name: getOrderHistory
methods.description: Returns the set of status history entries for the order.

methods.name: setOrderHistory
methods.description: Sets the order status history.

methods.name: setDelivery
methods.description: Sets delivery details for the order.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Returns delivery details for the order.

methods.name: setBilling
methods.description: Sets billing details for the order.

methods.name: getBilling
methods.description: Returns billing details for the order.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID associated with this order.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID associated with this order.

methods.name: getCustomerEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the customer's email address.

methods.name: setCustomerEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the customer's email address.

methods.name: setChannel
methods.description: Sets the order channel.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Returns the order channel.

methods.name: setCreditCard
methods.description: Sets the credit card details for the order.

methods.name: getCreditCard
methods.description: Returns the credit card details for the order.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the payment type.

methods.name: getPaymentType
methods.description: Returns the payment type.

methods.name: getOrderType
methods.description: Returns the order type.

methods.name: setOrderType
methods.description: Sets the order type.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale associated with the order.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for the order.
